Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You throw your arms wide and drive into the bodies around you, sending the whole front rank stumbling away.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Brawn
Target / range / shape
Every enemy adjacent when you begin.
Duration
Immediate displacement and Prone.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Roll Brawn once using the least favorable net Boons/Banes among the targets.

Weak
Push each 2 squares directly away from you.
Standard
Push each 3 squares.
Strong
Push each 4 squares and knock each prone.

Resolve the targets in an order you choose. No direct damage; normal collisions apply.

Additional rulings
